interface_findings.evidence: All four requests include only candidate source files, controls, feedback and edit metadata. Existing plan/read/answer local schemas are present, but no immutable host API contract or provider QA system prompts/output caps is included. The trace slot 1 patch extends both local instruction/schema tables and calls answer_retry; the immutable host whitelist rejects that stage.
interface_findings.recommendation: Add one versioned host-owned runtime_contract to both arms, naming closed RPC/stage sets, argument and result schemas, host call/search/read/input/output caps and answer-origin/quote rules. Clearly separate editable local instructions from fixed host system prompts. A retry must use an already supported stage and reserve capacity; it cannot extend the host API through candidate source.

interface_findings.evidence: The five top-level response fields and edit triplet are shown in prose, and max_edits=8/max_edit_chars=12000 are sent. The request does not explicitly describe closed objects/no duplicate JSON keys or the aggregate old+new character definition. Trace slot 1 adds old_occurrences to all five edits and one no-op; trace slot 0 loops on repeated string fields and reaches 18000 output tokens. These are returned-output failures, not evidence that JSON was damaged in transit.
interface_findings.recommendation: Send a compact exact output schema and one generic minimal valid example, explicitly prohibit extra/duplicate keys and old==new, and define max_edit_chars as sum(len(old)+len(new)). Keep current deterministic rejection and count each failed response; do not strip fields or silently repair old results. Any smaller output cap is a separately frozen common-arm change, not established effective by these four observations.

interface_findings.evidence: Host decision for trace slot 1 includes one recent rejection, but controlled projection forwards only operator/target/intended_target and sets experience=[]. Both slots have identical full provider bodies within each arm, enforced by the joint gate. Slot 1 never sees slot 0 rejection or code; cases children are same-root siblings.
interface_findings.recommendation: Retain this behavior for the independent proposal baseline. If testing repair/continuous evolution, register a distinct condition with a bounded same-arm rejection card and prior proposal identity; regenerate the gate for that declared request and retain the opportunity/cost cap. Do not describe the present independent sampling as a broken transport or a completed repair loop.

payload_findings.statement: Trace requests are 113741 bytes versus 46254; the added execution_flow/diagnostics occupy 67463 bytes. All 12 cases and the parent source remain present.

The cutoff is at edits[1].new. That object repeats key new 129 times, of which 128 complete values are the same 606-character string; the final occurrence is incomplete. This is malformed repetitive output, not evidence that a valid local patch simply needed a larger completion limit.
All five edit objects add old_occurrences; edit index 2 has identical old and new. The host correctly rejects this unchanged run output; removing extra fields alone would not make it valid.

The system instruction shows the expected fields and asks for localized edits, but does not explicitly say additional keys are forbidden or each old must differ from new. Numeric max_edit_chars appears in proposal_protocol. A future version can state all three constraints together and include a minimal valid example without changing historical outcomes.
